mapper.select: SELECT event.session_id, event.event_id, event.event_seq, event.anchor_entry_id, event.type, event.created_at, event.payload FROM t_session_execution_segments segment INNER JOIN t_session_executions execution ON execution.session_id = segment.session_id AND execution.execution_id = segment.execution_id AND execution.root_event_id = #{rootEventId} INNER JOIN t_session_execution_segment_events segment_event ON segment_event.session_id = segment.session_id AND segment_event.execution_id = segment.execution_id AND segment_event.segment_id = segment.segment_id INNER JOIN t_session_events event ON event.session_id = segment_event.session_id AND event.event_id = segment_event.event_id AND event.event_seq = segment_event.event_seq WHERE segment.session_id = #{sessionId} AND segment.execution_id = #{executionId} AND segment.segment_id = #{segmentId} AND segment_event.event_seq > #{afterSeq} AND (segment.terminal_event_seq IS NULL OR segment_event.event_seq <= segment.terminal_event_seq) ORDER BY segment_event.event_seq ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT event.session_id, event.event_id, event.event_seq, event.anchor_entry_id, event.type, event.created_at, event.payload FROM t_session_executions execution INNER JOIN t_session_execution_segments segment ON segment.session_id = execution.session_id AND segment.execution_id = execution.execution_id AND segment.segment_id = #{segmentId} INNER JOIN t_session_execution_segment_events segment_event ON segment_event.session_id = execution.session_id AND segment_event.execution_id = execution.execution_id AND segment_event.event_id = execution.terminal_event_id INNER JOIN t_session_events event ON event.session_id = segment_event.session_id AND event.event_id = segment_event.event_id AND event.event_seq = segment_event.event_seq WHERE execution.session_id = #{sessionId} AND execution.execution_id = #{executionId} AND execution.root_event_id = #{rootEventId} AND execution.state = 'TERMINAL'
